text:
deploy-bot: deploycheck FAILED for release v2026.03.21-7 -> prod
Reason: tls secret 'inference-frontend-tls' subjectAltNames differ between staging and prod. blocking promotion :rotating_light:
https://deploys.redwood/release/v2026.03.21-7/checks/7890

mike: seeing it. deploybot shows CN=staging.internal.redwood and prod uses CN=*.redwood-inference.com — LB will reject SNI.

anya: how did that get out of sync? we use the same secret name in sops, right?

ben: quick recap: ops auto-rotate ran in staging at 02:12 UTC and replaced SANs for regional test cert. prod rotation errored out due to KMS alias fetch failure (looks like a transient KMS permission hiccup). staging got a new cert, prod still has the old wildcard.

sara: release window is open. customers hit prod if we push this image with updated nginx -> will fail TLS for some hosts. rollback seems safest.

mike: +1 rollback. recommend revert to v2026.03.20-hotfix which is already validated. @release-coordinator can you approve and trigger?

release-coordinator: approved. pausing promotion to prod and marking the job: "rollback-for-cert-parity". I'll add a note to the release notes: "Rollback due to TLS cert SAN mismatch between staging/prod; infra rotation in progress."

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: promoting v2026.03.20-hotfix -> prod (job id 7901). ETA ~4m. Posting status updates here.

anya: i'll open a tiny PR to sops/certs to normalize CN+SAN generation and add a CI check that compares SANs across env branches. tagging @ben for quick review. should avoid future silent drifts.

ben: ack — will review ASAP. if patch merges within the change window we can re-promote after infra confirms cert sync. otherwise keep rollback and schedule a follow-up release.

infra-bot: rotation job logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T02:12:03Z ERROR fetch_kms_alias: AccessDenied for alias/rotations/prod
2026-03-21T02:12:04Z INFO rotation aborted for namespace=prod
```

sara: noted. pinging infra on-call to re-run rotation and verify KMS perms. @infra-team please confirm when prod cert updated.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: prod now on v2026.03.20-hotfix. all health checks green. marking release as "paused - awaiting cert parity".

mike: thanks all. i'll hold any further promos until sops PR and a successful prod rotation. adding a short entry to release notes and support playbook about this class of drift. :memo:
